Five different human cancer cell lines, representing BrCa including MDA-MB-231, MCF-7 and SK-BR-3 and colorectal cancer including SW-480 and HT-29, were used in this study.

sample_source.evidence: A total of 24 clinical tissue samples, representing breast and colorectal types of cancer, were obtained from the Strathfield Breast Cancer Centre, Sydney and the Victorian Cancer Biobank, Melbourne, Australia, respectively.

The cell lines were cultured in Dulbecco’s modified eagle medium (DMEM) (Thermofisher, 11965092), supplemented with 10% foetal bovine serum (Scientifix Australia, SFBS) and 1% antibiotics (penicillin-streptomycin) (Sigma-Aldrich, P4333).
